podcast.title: Defense Against "Boring" Criticism (1973)
podcast.body: In 1973, Richard Carpenter defended The Carpenters' music against accusations of being boring, asserting, "we're pop, but we're not that kind of bland, unimaginative pop music." He took pride in selecting and arranging their songs. "He said in 1973, we're pop, but we're not that kind of bland, unimaginative pop music."

podcast.title: Struggling with Public Image (1970s)
podcast.body: Richard Carpenter admitted to being "sick of smiling" due to the pressure of maintaining The Carpenters' wholesome public image, despite understanding the need to "give the people what they want." "Richard was sick of smiling, but you have to give the people what they want."
